# Za stromom (Behind the Tree)

> A free satirical 2D browser game about a brown bear from Liptov, Slovakia. Politicians blame bears for everything, hunters shoot even where bears are protected, the STRACH 24 news channel reports one breaking story after another, and the only safe place is behind a thick tree. Plays in any desktop or mobile browser, no install. Languages: Slovak, English, German, Spanish.

## Play

- [Play in Slovak](https://zastromom.sk/)
- [Play in English](https://zastromom.sk/?lang=en)
- [Play in German](https://zastromom.sk/?lang=de)
- [Play in Spanish](https://zastromom.sk/?lang=es)
- [itch.io page](https://damikun.itch.io/za-stromom)

## About the game

- Goal: guide the bear to its den with enough fat (85% in summer, 65% in winter, 75% on Ďumbier) and hug a person at least once; a selfie with a tourist counts too.
- Summer in the Valley: the village of Dolný Strach, a cornfield with a wild boar, the Pribylina open-air museum, a sheepfold with a koliba, the Belá ford with a wildlife photographer, a hotel, a chairlift ride and a climb to Zelené pleso in the High Tatras.
- Winter on the Slopes: snow cannons, the Christmas market of Liptovský Mikuláš with a sheep-cheese stall, a ski resort, a chairlift, a Christmas-tree lot and an ice fisherman.
- Up to Ďumbier: a car park and a road in Demänovská dolina, a bat census in the Cave of Liberty (hide behind a column or freeze like a stalagmite when the tour turns your way, a miner's helmet for the closed part, rock ledges, narrow passages with a brook, a hall and a river, and no way out before the bats are counted), a forest climb to the hotels of Jasná, a cable car cabin to the Rotunda that the bear keeps balanced as the crowd rushes between windows, a steep descent to a queue for cabbage soup at Kamenná chata, a Low Tatras ridge with fog, wind, chamois and marmots, and Minister Strašiak's press conference on the summit of Ďumbier.
- Controls: arrows to walk, Shift to sprint, Down to hide behind a thick tree or in hay, Up to jump or hold to climb, Space to jump on a hunter's head, C to hug, take a selfie, shake a hunting stand or knock, X to bite, P to pause, M for sound.
- Satire: a fictional Minister Strašiak, MP Flinta and the STRACH 24 channel parody the Slovak bear-cull debate. All characters are fictional.
